content_blocks.code: WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT DATE('2026-10-10') AS sold_on, 10 AS amount UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2026-10-11'), 15) SELECT sold_on, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY sold_on) AS running_total FROM daily_sales ORDER BY sold_on;
content_blocks.expected_output: Rows show running_total 10 then 25; use the explicit ORDER BY to define the running sequence.
